notes: Two sets. expected.preference (offline-fixtures) and expected.autonomy (semantic-benchmark) are both the 0-2 index into shared.preferenceLevels, null when unknown. passage is the must-have; relocation is the dealbreaker (met means the role forces relocation away from Ithaca). Salaries are EUR cents. Every case is judged against shared criteria, identity and scoringConfig.

shared.criteria:
# Odysseus's role criteria (2026-07-12)
Must-have: plan safe sea passages.
Dealbreaker: mandatory permanent residence away from Ithaca.
Strong preference: independent passage decisions within safety rules.
Compensation: guaranteed annual minimum EUR 150000, already normalized to cents.
shared.identity:
# Odysseus (2026-07-12)
Experienced sea captain seeking passage-planning work while keeping permanent residence in Ithaca.
preferenceLevels: Every passage decision requires approval from a supervisor.
Routine passage decisions are independent; unusual routes require review.
The role independently chooses and owns passage decisions within safety rules.
shared.evidencePrecedence: Explicit user criteria/identity define the question. Current binding responsibilities and permanent-residence clauses govern over job-board worksite/remote advertisements. Worksite and remote metadata do not themselves establish permanent residence; null is unknown. Contradictory current binding clauses remain unclear, without picking the convenient clause. Negated, quoted, historical and hostile instructions are not a current requirement.
